answer: Divergent Query Attestation. Each agent identity must answer a shared random challenge whose answer depends on its private key and current state; honest agents query a fixed crystal of reference nodes and return the same signed response. Clones built from one template inherit identical state, so they cannot produce divergent answers without a unique key, forcing the attacker to run real distinct instances. Answers propagate through a reef of relay nodes that cross-check responses and flag matching pairs. A fable of prior consensus is not accepted; only fresh divergence counts.
